locations.label: Sentinel Artifact
locations.description: Open the Amphitheater and interact with the Sentinel Artifact. Headshot the skeletons so they stay dead, then survive until Pegasus finishes the lockdown. Find the Golden Bridle on its pedestal at either Intersection of Treasuries, between the red crystal and cart, or Stoa of the Athenians beside the descending stairs. Kill the Gegenees it summons and collect the shield body. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Apollo’s Will workbench
locations.description: Collect Apollo’s Will’s handle and spear, then build the shield at the Marketplace bench beside the Saug wallbuy. Ride Pegasus from the blue circle at Spartan Monument to River of Sorrow. Open both eagle cages with your Specialist: shoot down the hanging Python Pass cage first; the other is on the ground in Cliff Ruins by the Koshka. Go to Center of the World and survive until the eagles reveal Pack-a-Punch. Handle group, River Pass / Upper Road bridge: lower bridge support, rock near the upper bridge, or rock in the river underneath. Spear group: Stoa of the Athenians behind the Mozu wall; Intersection of Treasuries opposite Mozu; or statue base across from Auger DMR. The shield body comes from a Gegenees. Use shield spear throws at its head when later Gegenees need to be killed. Fast-travel portals open after Pack-a-Punch. Collect the three Pegasus Strike parts during this first Dark Side visit to save a later search. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Eternal Flame / tribute bowls
locations.description: Start tribute challenges at the bowls in Temple of Apollo or Cliff Ruins. Keep completing tasks to raise your personal reward rarity, then claim rewards at the Temple pillars. The Eternal Flame needs nine tribute points per player in the match: Common = 0.5, Rare = 1, Legendary = 4, Epic = 6. Check that the Temple flame turns blue before continuing. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Ballista / symbol door
locations.description: At River of Sorrow, find the symbol door beside the Spitfire wallbuy. Use a bullet weapon to shoot the six panels in the numbered order in the image. Reading rows from top and columns from left, the positions are R3 C2 → R1 C2 → R3 C5 → R4 C4 → R2 C1 → R2 C4. A wrong shot clears the display; restart from the first panel. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.

locations.label: Boss portal entrance
locations.description: The shot opens the boss portal behind Pack-a-Punch at Center of the World. Gather the team, refill weapons and shield, bring a charged Specialist and your preferred crowd-control hand, then interact together. The portal begins the final encounter. This marker identifies the named region on a diagram, not a measured object coordinate.
